purpose: Fail-closed disposition of current V3 operational reviews after partial-label contradiction precedence was corrected. Decisions are case-bound and do not alter resolver policy.

decisions.rationale: The official specification contains both GT and Dark Horse 5.0 V8 coupe configurations. Engine, generation and body style do not determine the missing variant.
The official Porsche evidence distinguishes Carrera variants. A generic Carrera label does not establish Carrera 4S identity.
The retained BMW reference distinguishes specific G20 configurations. A generic G20 3 Series 2.0 petrol observation does not itself establish the 330i variant label.
Toyota MY25 evidence contains multiple hybrid trims. Missing variant evidence cannot be deterministically assigned to XRX Hybrid.
Official Chevrolet MY25 material contains multiple Turbo 116cv automatic hatch configurations. Mechanical identity and model year do not uniquely prove Premier when variant is absent.
Official Volkswagen evidence contains more than one 250 TSI T-Cross trim. A generic 250 TSI observation cannot determine the missing variant.
FIPE lookup requires code plus model year under the curated semantics. A shared code without model-year evidence is insufficient for deterministic catalog identity.

The evidence establishes the Highline 250 TSI mechanical family and MY26 context but does not establish that the yearless observation itself is MY26. Senatran-aligned policy therefore preserves REVIEW.
